paragraphs.text: Ferret is a unique creature type depicting a weasel -like, often albino, mammal that is often trained to hunt rats or rabbits . It's closely related to the polecat , and sables such as the Bronze Sable .
Ferret has only been used for Joven's Ferrets ( Homelands ). It was however printed in its plural from and was never actually printed with the singular form on the typeline.

Since the Weasel creature type was introduced in Bloomburrow , it is a possibility that ferret will be errata 'd. However, R&D is unlikely to make that kind of errata without some typal support to make such a change relevant.
The only planes confirmed to have ferrets are Ulgrotha and Dominaria . Joven 's ferrets were probably used for burglary.
